eventDescription: Old pinery includes slip n slide, obstacle course, archery and other camping activities and games.
High Adventure consists of staying in yurts up pole canyon. Archery, shooting and other camping activities.

Staying 4 days and 3 nights at cabin in Timber Lakes above Heber, Utah. We will be spending time at the cabin doing crafts, playing games, having devotional, and other similar activities. We will be watching David for our movie night. We will be going on a hike near the cabin. We will also be spending time at Deer Creek Reservoir playing in the water and spending time on the beach.
